title: Typography

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Limit typographic variation in moving images so viewers can read quickly without losing a consistent voice.
strategic_value: Restricting video to Regular and Bold can keep Helsinki’s changing messages recognizable.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture pairs the video weight rule with a specimen that emphasizes Regular and Bold while fading Medium and Black.
practical_value: Choose Regular or Bold, including their italics, for video and animation rather than importing every available weight.

content_islands.name: Video type rule
content_islands.spec: Place the allowed-style explanation above the specimen.

content_islands.name: Weight comparison
content_islands.spec: Show the allowed and faded weights in a shared two-column character display.

ingredient.name: Helsinki Grotesk video weights
ingredient.role: Give moving-image text a consistent voice.
ingredient.application: Use Regular or Bold; either may be italic.
ingredient.scope: Video and animation materials; specimen examples are guidance.

reference_purposes.Application: The text assigns Helsinki Grotesk Regular and Bold, with italic options, to video and animation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Only Regular and Bold are permitted here; the specimen examples are described as guidance only.
reference_purposes.Expression: The specimen compares the selected styles through alphabets, numerals and punctuation.
